title: The De-Googled Android Stack: keyboard, launcher, and updates

intro.headline: Type privately, search instantly, and update straight from the source.
intro.subhead: HeliBoard, Kvaesitso, and Obtainium replace Gboard, commercial launchers, and the Play Store with zero telemetry.
